title: Count AI-assisted commits via co-author trailers
context: change-history counted AI commits by git author name only; repos with human authors and a Claude co-author trailer reported 0.
decision: Collector reads Co-authored-by trailers (NUL-delimited git log format); CommitEntry.is_ai_assisted matches 'claude' in author or co-author display name, email ignored.
consequences: Report counts 1707 of 1880 commits AI-assisted here; matching stays a name heuristic (a human named Claude is miscounted).
rationale: Smallest fix in the existing collector; both architecture reviewers approved. NUL delimiters also fix a pipe-in-subject field shift.
rejected: Counting from the event log (ties report to Shipwright tooling); doing nothing.
